answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization models aim to generate a shorter text sequence as the summary of an input document.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE as the automatic evaluation metric for performance comparison. More specifically, we report the F1 scores of ROUGE-1/2/L in our experiments.

answer_4.quote: we conduct human evaluation for the coherence of system-generated summaries on GovReport dataset
answer_4.guideline: a fine-grained human evaluation protocol which requires the annotators to identify different types of span-level coherence errors in the summaries
